title: Ubuntu: I am because we are
examples: What is the main idea behind Ubuntu?
How is Ubuntu different from just being nice?
Can you give an example of Ubuntu in modern life?

explain.say: Today we explore a powerful idea called Ubuntu.

draw.text: Ubuntu: I am because we are

items: Ubuntu is a concept from African philosophy.
It emphasizes community over the individual.
It suggests our humanity comes from others.

draw.text: Ubuntu: I am because we are

explain.say: Ubuntu suggests that a person's humanity is found within their relationships.
It means that we are fundamentally connected to every person around us.
A core part of Ubuntu is recognizing the shared existence of all people.
In daily life, Ubuntu means showing compassion when a friend struggles.
A common mistake is thinking that helping others weakens you personally.

faq.q: What is the literal meaning of Ubuntu?
faq.a: It is often translated as 'humanity towards others' or 'I am because we are'.
asks: What does the word Ubuntu mean?
Can you explain the meaning of Ubuntu?

faq.q: Is Ubuntu just about being nice to people?
faq.a: No, it is a deep philosophical concept about interdependence, not just simple kindness.
asks: Is it the same as empathy?

faq.q: Does Ubuntu only apply to African cultures?
faq.a: While originating in African philosophy, its principles of community are universal ideas.
asks: Is this concept limited to one region?
Can non-African people use this idea?

faq.a: It encourages decisions that benefit the whole community, not just one person.
asks: Should I think about the group when I decide?
What does Ubuntu suggest about choices?

faq.q: Is Ubuntu the same as collectivism?
faq.a: They are related, but Ubuntu is more about recognizing inherent shared humanity than just group ownership.
asks: What is the difference between Ubuntu and group loyalty?

facts: Ubuntu is a concept originating from various Bantu cultures in Africa.
It emphasizes that a person's identity is formed within a community context.
The philosophy stresses mutual care and shared humanity.
It suggests that one cannot be fully human in isolation.

quiz.say: If you help a classmate study for a difficult test, you are practicing:
quiz.why: Because your action supports the community's success.

wrong.0: This suggests you helped because you were forced to.
wrong.1: This suggests you helped because they were weak.
wrong.3: This suggests you only helped to make yourself look good.

quiz.say: The idea that our humanity comes from others is best described as:
quiz.why: It means we rely on each other to be fully human.

wrong.0: This suggests you do not need anyone else.
wrong.1: This suggests you are never dependent on anyone.
wrong.3: This suggests you can be fully human alone.

quiz.say: Which word best captures the core idea of Ubuntu?
quiz.why: Ubuntu places the group and relationships at the center.

wrong.0: This focuses only on the self, which is the opposite.
wrong.1: This focuses on winning against others.
wrong.2: This suggests people should keep distance.
